summary: At segment 0 step 62, dig() skips the trapped-door call to trap.c:b_trapped(). C draws rnd(6)=6 before the pending KABOOM message forces a door-break --More-- page; JavaScript continues the turn instead. Port the whole b_trapped() function and wire its source callers, preserving explosion damage, attribute exercise, stun timeout, and asynchronous message order.

source.branch: The hero completes digging effort above 100 against a DOOR carrying D_TRAPPED. dig() prints the break-through message, changes the door mask to D_NODOOR, then calls b_trapped("door", NO_PART) before recalc_block_point(), newsym(), and digging cleanup. b_trapped computes damage from level_difficulty(), prints KABOOM, wakes nearby monsters, applies Maybe_Half_Phys damage, exercises Strength negatively, exercises Constitution only for a bodypart other than NO_PART, and adds the unhalved damage to the existing HStun timeout.
callers: C dig.c:dig():300-570 calls b_trapped("door", NO_PART) at 536 after the message and door-mask change. At examined commit 9758aabc, js/dig.js:dig():395-748 reaches the same D_TRAPPED arm at 691-697 but uses note_unported("trap.c b_trapped") at 694.

C dig.c:use_pick_axe2() registers dig as an occupation at 1311 and 1356; JS js/dig.js:use_pick_axe2() registers the same exported dig callback at 1055 and 1112. The assigned keys a, p, l reach application of the pick-axe and eastward digging; the occupation completes during recorded step 61 and the message continuation is step 62.

Other C caller sites are eat.c:consume_tin():1538 (tin, NO_PART), hack.c:still_chewing():788/802 (secret door or door, NO_PART), lock.c:picklock():141 and doopen_indir():908 (door, FINGER), detect.c:openone():1753 (door, NO_PART), trap.c:untrap():6076 (door, FINGER), and dokick.c:kick_door():939/988 (door, FOOT). Inventory these source sites and replace existing source-named b_trapped gaps when wiring the whole function; refusal-backed caller branches must retain their separate incomplete-source status.
dependencies: dungeon.c:level_difficulty() supplies the consumed damage bound; js/dungeon.js:level_difficulty() is implemented. On this Dlvl:1 witness the expression is 5+1=6; preserve C integer division for lvl>=5.
mon.c:wake_nearby(FALSE) is implemented by js/mon.js:wake_nearby(), taking false plus an environment containing state. Preserve its position after the explosion message and before damage.
hack.c:losehp() is implemented by js/hack.js:losehp(); preserve Maybe_Half_Phys(dmg), killer "explosion", and KILLED_BY_AN. trap.js already has the physical-damage helper and imports losehp.

attrib.c:exercise() and potion.c:make_stunned() are implemented and imported by trap.js. Call exercise(A_STR,FALSE); call exercise(A_CON,FALSE) only for bodypart!=NO_PART; then make_stunned((HStun & TIMEOUT)+dmg,TRUE). Do not halve the stun increment when physical damage is halved.

The C Soundeffect call precedes pline. If the corresponding sound operation remains unported, retain a source-named discarded-call gap rather than invent output or random draws. All message-producing calls need asynchronous sequencing so --More-- suspends before wake, damage, exercise, stun, and caller map cleanup.
